body:
Add Bubblewrap installation and user-namespace verification steps to .github/workflows/publish.yml so that Linux sandbox containment checks pass during npm test prior to npm publish.

Acceptance criteria:
1. .github/workflows/publish.yml installs bubblewrap and verifies userns before tests.
2. Rails guard passes: rails lib/lock.mjs and lib/gates.mjs remain untouched.
3. npm test passes locally.
4. GitHub Actions publish workflow successfully runs tests and proceeds to npm-publish deployment.
title: Install Bubblewrap in publish workflow for test containment
